item.text: {"case_id":"SHC034","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C25","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. Beyond the standard IEEPA framework, its core designation criterion is unusually close to the child: persons who committed or pose a significant risk of committing acts of violence having the purpose or effect of threatening peace or stability, followed by materially-assisting and owned-or-controlled prongs. The child adapts that same substantive machinery from Western Balkans stabilization to Iraq and preserves the sequence of property blocking, support and control criteria, contribution prohibitions, evasion and conspiracy provisions, definitions, and Treasury implementation. C25 and C05 closely match the later, polished sanctions-order structure, but their target criteria are less textually congruent with the child's central violence-and-stabilization
